cargakawaii.tip.label: Cute tip
cargakawaii.tip.generic.1: Take a deep breath... almost there!
cargakawaii.tip.generic.2: A virtual hug for you while the world loads.
cargakawaii.tip.generic.3: The blocks are doing their hair to welcome you.
cargakawaii.tip.generic.4: Today is going to be a great day for adventures.
cargakawaii.tip.generic.5: Remember to drink some water and stretch your little hands.
cargakawaii.tip.generic.6: The best worlds load slowly and with love.
cargakawaii.tip.generic.7: Plant flowers, take care of animals and be kind.
cargakawaii.tip.generic.8: A smile counts as loot too.
cargakawaii.tip.melon.1: Magic hearts raise your Innocence: pick them up from the ground!
cargakawaii.tip.melon.2: With Innocence 3 or higher, Maos come closer to you.
cargakawaii.tip.melon.3: Give Mao a golden carrot to tame it.
cargakawaii.tip.melon.5: Type "Mao, tell me the nearby ores" and he will help you.
cargakawaii.tip.melon.6: Harvesting and trading with villagers also raises your Innocence.
cargakawaii.tip.melon.7: The more Innocence you have, the kinder mobs become to you.
cargakawaii.tip.flowy.2: Flowys fly around the fields in flocks.
cargakawaii.tip.flowy.3: Flowys say nice things to you: listen to them!
cargakawaii.tip.flowy.4: Sometimes Flowys gift you seeds and flowers.
cargakawaii.tip.flowy.5: You can ask your Flowy to stay put or to follow you.
cargakawaii.tip.nutria.2: Otters love playing in the water.
cargakawaii.tip.nutria.3: Your otter is immortal and defends you.
cargakawaii.tip.nutria.4: At max friendship, your otter hits like a diamond sword.
